title: The Corridor
time: 11:00 in Ward 4 (the day of 3.2); the flashback: a rainy Thursday months ago, your first week in Bangalore, 01:52 → 02:14; back in the ward at 18:30
player_goal: Be Ravi for one night shift: walk the corridor, take the call, put the tray down.
design_goal: The peak of Act 3's quiet: the player causes the outbreak with their own hands and nothing dramatic happens. One choice that isn't a choice (Ignore is greyed out — you'd answer too), one station you walk past, one box left unticked. Then the ant: what the agent was built to do, and what it does in people. The guilt stays Ravi's, the understanding becomes the player's.

cast.role: After 'I answered' (ravi_ward_talked), talking to him again: 'You want to know?' → 'Tell me.' starts the flashback; 'Rest, Ravi.' leaves it for later (you can come back). In the corridor you ARE Ravi (district playerSheet npc_ravi, HUD objective only). Appa is a voice on the phone (dlg_appa_call): 'Ravi? Sorry, sorry, I know it's late. Your Amma's in the hospital again — no, don't come, it's nothing, it's the sugar. I just wanted to hear you.' Ravi: 'I'm at work, Appa. I'll call in the morning.' Appa: 'Eat something. You sound thin.'

beats.what: Ward 4, after 'I answered': 'You want to know?' → 'Tell me.' A card: 'HIVR · CONTAINMENT CORRIDOR · THURSDAY 01:52 — your first week in Bangalore. It was raining.' You are Ravi at the airlock. The HUD shows only the objective (no wallet, no clock of yours).

The corridor: cold light, a rain-streaked window, the clipboard on the wall (the night checklist: [x] Gown · [x] Mask · [x] Double gloves · [ ] Glove change at station B, before the slide room), the glove-change station halfway, the slide room at the end with tray AMR-07 under the hood.

Halfway down the corridor his phone buzzes: APPA. Two choices — Answer / Ignore — and Ignore is greyed out (locked, shown: 'It's Appa.'). The call, three lines. After it, the glove station: step to it and Ravi's thought cuts in — '(Your hands are shaking. After the tray.)' — and you walk on. The slide room: the tray goes down under the hood, unsealed. Nothing happens. The clipboard, once more: one unticked box.

Cut to the ant (a card sequence of four illustrated stills, documentary-plain, no gore): a spore on an ant's back → the ant climbs a grass stem, away from the colony → it clamps the underside of a leaf → a thin stalk grows from its head. Black. Ravi's voice over it: 'Ours stops at the climbing part. In people, I mean. They don't die. They just... keep going.' One silent frame: the next morning, a locker with a name strip (VIKRAM), a raincoat still dripping onto the floor. Back to Ward 4 at 18:30, Ravi asleep.

exits.note: in by card_corridor_in (Ravi's 'Tell me.'), out by card_corridor_out (the tray) — landings, ADR-137/138
